faq.headline: Managed Services, ICT & Low Current, Cybersecurity and AI in Saudi Arabia
faq.body:
RCS Arabia is a new Riyadh-based managed services and low current company, led by a team with 30+ years in Saudi IT. Our services are organised into five pillars: managed services, ICT and low current systems, cybersecurity, AI and data, and software and cloud engineering.

We design, deploy, operate and secure the technology that organisations depend on. From the service desk to the data center, and from custom applications to security operations, one accountable team works with you through assessment, design, transition, operation and continual improvement.

With Saudi talent, Kingdom-wide reach and leadership experience across banking, telecom, healthcare and enterprise, RCS Arabia helps organisations run technology that is dependable, secure and ready to grow.
faq.q1: What services does RCS Arabia provide in Saudi Arabia?
faq.a1: RCS Arabia provides services in five pillars: managed services, ICT and low current systems, cybersecurity, AI and data, and software and cloud engineering. Each pillar is delivered by one accountable team, from design and installation to day-to-day operation.
faq.q2: Does RCS Arabia offer managed IT services with SLAs?
faq.a2: Yes. Our managed services cover 34 services in seven categories, from the service desk and field support to infrastructure, monitoring, applications and industry-specific platforms. They run with 24/7 support under clear SLAs and give you predictable monthly costs.
faq.q3: Which sectors does RCS Arabia support?
faq.a3: Our services are used by organisations in banking, healthcare, government, telecom, facilities and hospitality, among others. Managed services, cybersecurity, ICT and audio visual systems, and AI and data services are adapted to the operating realities of each sector.
faq.q4: Does RCS Arabia provide cybersecurity services?
faq.a4: Yes. Our cybersecurity pillar runs continuous protection as a service, covering security operations, vulnerability management, managed firewalls, endpoint security, identity and privileged access, and application security testing. It supports your regulatory and audit requirements.

privacy_policy.headline: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.intro: RCS Arabia is committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect when you visit our website or contact us, how we use it, and the choices you have. By using our website, you agree to the practices described here.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body:
We may collect the following types of information:

• Contact information you provide directly — such as your name, job title, organisation, email address, phone number and message content — when you submit an enquiry form or email us.

• Usage data collected automatically — including your IP address, browser type, pages visited, time spent on pages and referring URLs — through cookies and similar technologies.

• Analytics data collected through tools such as Google Analytics, which help us understand how visitors use the site so we can improve it. Google Analytics may set cookies on your device.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.body:
We use the information we collect to:

• Respond to your enquiries and provide the services you have requested.
• Send relevant follow-up communications about our services, where you have consented or where we have a legitimate business interest.
• Analyse and improve the performance and usability of our website.
• Comply with legal and regulatory obligations applicable in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

We do not use your personal data for automated decision-making or profiling.

sections.heading: 3. Cookies and Tracking
sections.body:
Our website uses cookies — small text files placed on your device — to help us understand how visitors interact with our content. We use:

• Essential cookies that are required for the website to function.
• Analytics cookies (including Google Analytics) that help us measure traffic and usage patterns.

You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings at any time. Disabling cookies may affect some features of the website.

sections.heading: 4. How We Share Your Information
sections.body:
We do not sell, rent or trade your personal information to third parties. We may share your information only in the following limited circumstances:

• With trusted service providers who assist us in operating the website or communicating with you (such as email delivery or analytics providers), under strict data processing agreements.
• When required by law or a lawful order from a competent authority in Saudi Arabia.
• In connection with a business transfer, merger or acquisition — in which case the new entity will be bound by this Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: 5. Data Retention
sections.body: We retain personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes described in this policy, or as required by applicable law. Enquiry data is typically retained for up to three years. Analytics data is retained in accordance with the default retention settings of the applicable analytics provider. You may request deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us.

sections.heading: 6. Data Security
sections.body: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal information from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration or destruction. These include encrypted data transmission (HTTPS), access controls, and regular security reviews. While we take all reasonable precautions, no transmission of data over the internet is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: 7. Your Rights
sections.body:
Subject to applicable Saudi Arabian law, you have the right to:

• Access the personal information we hold about you.
• Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information.
• Request deletion of your personal information, where no legal obligation requires us to retain it.
• Withdraw consent at any time where processing is based on consent.

To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at info@rcsarabia.com. We will respond within a reasonable timeframe.

sections.heading: 8. Third-Party Links
sections.body: Our website may contain links to third-party websites. This Privacy Policy applies only to our website. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of other sites and encourage you to review their policies before submitting any personal information.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. When we do, we will update the 'Last Updated' date at the top of this page. We encourage you to review this policy periodically. Your continued use of the website after any changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

sections.heading: 10. Contact Us
sections.body:
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your personal data, please contact us:
